records.context: Re-measure the glyph when the heading font changes.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.dock.SectionHeader.event#0
records.source: Re-measure the glyph when the heading font changes.
records.translation: 제목 글꼴이 바뀌면 기호를 다시 측정합니다.

records.context: Draw the heading with its disclosure glyph before the name.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.dock.SectionHeader.paintEvent#0
records.source: Draw the heading with its disclosure glyph before the name.
records.translation: 이름 앞에 접기 기호를 붙여 제목을 그립니다.

records.context: The glyph is painted rather than put in the text, so the heading's text stays the section name that lookups and translation work from. The text is pushed right by the glyph's advance through the label indent.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.dock.SectionHeader.paintEvent#1
records.source: The glyph is painted rather than put in the text, so the heading's text stays the section name that lookups and translation work from. The text is pushed right by the glyph's advance through the label indent.
records.translation: 기호는 텍스트에 넣지 않고 따로 그리므로, 제목의 텍스트는 조회와 번역이 사용하는 섹션 이름 그대로 유지됩니다. 텍스트는 레이블 들여쓰기를 통해 기호의 너비만큼 오른쪽으로 밀립니다.

records.context: Show the glyph for an open or folded section and make room for it.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.dock.SectionHeader.set_open#0
records.source: Show the glyph for an open or folded section and make room for it.
records.translation: 열린 섹션이나 접힌 섹션의 기호를 표시하고 그 자리를 마련합니다.

records.context: true when the section's rows are shown.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.dock.SectionHeader.set_open#1
records.source: true when the section's rows are shown.
